room.hall.title: Hall
room.hall.description: A bare hall with a [stone floor](floor) and an [iron hook](hook) by the door.
item.key.room: A [small key] lies in the dust.
item.key.description: An iron key, cold and plain.
quest.find_key.title: The lost key
quest.find_key.found: You have the key. Hang it on its hook before the keeper gives up.
quest.find_key.failed: Too late: the keeper changed the lock.
quest.find_key.abandoned: You gave up on the key.
quest.find_key.hint_look: Look at the floor of the hall.
quest.find_key.hint_take: Take the key from the dust.
quest.find_key.hint_return: Hang the key back on the hook by the door.
detail.floor: Grey flagstones under a skin of dust.
narration.search_floor: You run your hands through the dust.
tip.search_floor: Searching takes no time here; search wherever something looks out of place.
detail.hook: An iron hook, bare, waiting for its key.
actions.hang_key: Hang the key on the hook
narration.hang_key: You hang the key on its hook.
